doc: One call to a plot system (design/plotter.md, Growing): the bound config, the ground, what already stands, what to keep clear this time, and how much to grow.

fields.name: exclusions
fields.doc: What to keep clear for this call.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Seed (a new region) or regrow (filling what was cleared).

fields.name: focus
fields.doc: Placements nearest this come first, when use_focus is set.

fields.name: use_focus
fields.doc: Order by distance to focus instead of by priority.

fields.name: want_cells
fields.doc: Also return the resolved cells (for viewing).
